faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Delhi Nursing Officer/Project Technical Support-III recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 25 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated email address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification is a Three Year Graduation in a relevant subject along with three years of experience, or a Postgraduate degree in the relevant subject or field.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: The official notification does not explicitly mention age relaxation details. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification for any such provisions.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Nursing Officer/Project Technical Support-III position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 28,000 per month plus House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for this job?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to send your complete bio-data and required documents to the specified email address before the last date.

faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the post of Nursing Officer/Project Technical Support-III.
